title: The Social Engineer Who Got a Navy Code Using a Library Book

why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme, shocking outcome from a seemingly innocent action; viewers will be horrified and fascinated by how easily a crowd can be weaponized.

title: The Real Mind Control That Made a Man Shut Down His Own Kidneys—by Thinking
hook: A patient was told he was dying of kidney failure. His body believed it so completely that his kidneys stopped working—even though he was perfectly healthy.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into the terrifying power of belief and the nocebo effect—viewers love stories where the mind literally controls the body to the point of destruction.

why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an entire community erasing a memory is both eerie and intriguing—perfect for true-crime and psychology crossover fans.

title: The Cognitive Bias That Made a Doctor Diagnose Cancer—in a Healthy Man
